correctness.rationale: For any real signal, coarea plus triangle inequality reduces the sharp Gini ratio to nonconstant binary cut indicators, then complements arrange hub 0. For fixed rim-cardinality k, the selected outputs exceed all unselected ones after multiplying by six; sorted partial sums are majorized by those of a single contiguous arc, including the same hub output 3k/m. Schur-convex pairwise Gini sum proves the global arc maximum. Direct rational level counting gives the piecewise R_m(k)-5/6 numerators; their integer inequalities prove <=5/6 through 28 and k=6 gives >5/6 at every m>=29 (first 10441/12528). The positive doubly stochastic rank-one gauge establishes L_m<1, and singleton and gauge bounds squeeze limit 5/6; row overlap gives delta=5/6 m>=6. Independent exact Fraction checks enumerated all hub-zero rim cuts for m=3..10, all arcs m=3..79 and the m29 witness. Finite tests corroborate, not prove, universal m.
